notes: New: Running now has tabs: Safe to close, Hardware, Windows and All, so it's easier to see what you can close.
New: Tick several programs and press Close selected to close them all at once.
New: Hardware programs, like graphics, audio, lighting and keyboard or mouse tools, are listed separately and marked Needed so you don't close them by accident.
Improved: Picking fixes now uses checkboxes. A checked box means the fix is made when you press Apply.
Improved: The Startup apps list now has a "Fix" column to match the new checkboxes.
Improved: Running now shows "None" when a tab has nothing in it.
Fixed: Messages no longer pile up on top of each other. A new one replaces the old one.
